metadata.domain: Large Language Model / Foundation Model / AI Platform

evidence.trl_pathway: T01 (TRL 6) and T05 (TRL 6) have reasonable 2-year development windows, but T02 (TRL 5) is scheduled to complete in 0 quarters (2030-Q1 → 2030-Q1), which is effectively a zero-duration development cycle — entirely unrealistic for a TRL 5 technology needing to reach deployment readiness.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The portfolio includes some R&D-oriented technologies (T02 at TRL 5) consistent with 기술선도, but two of three selections are already at TRL 6 (near-commercial), and the overall portfolio depth (only 3 technologies) and late timing suggest insufficient exploratory investment for a true technology leadership strategy.
evidence.competitive_awareness: All three technologies align well with the declared LLM/Foundation Model/AI Platform domain — context-aware collaboration, inference acceleration, and generative 3D spatial creation are all on-domain selections with clear differentiation potential in the AI platform space.
evidence.market_timing: All three technologies complete significantly after their market boom windows (T01: +1.5yr, T05: +2.75yr, T02: +1.75yr), with a mean error of 2.0 years. For 기술선도, completion 1-2 years BEFORE boom is ideal; instead, the roadmap consistently delivers technologies well after peak market opportunity.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selections span architecture and equipment categories with plausible convergence signals (LLM collaboration and inference acceleration are active patent filing areas), but no explicit evidence in the roadmap demonstrates deliberate targeting of patent-market convergence zones — the alignment appears incidental.

strengths: Strong domain coherence — all selected technologies are clearly within the LLM/AI Platform domain with no off-domain drift
Dependency chain is logically structured (T01 → T05 → T02), reflecting sound technological sequencing
weaknesses: Systematic late-to-market timing: all technologies complete after their boom windows, undermining both technology leadership and market capture objectives
T02 (생성형 AI 기반 3D 공간 생성) has a zero-duration development window (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1) which is technically impossible for a TRL 5 technology
missing_technologies: Multi-agent orchestration framework (lower TRL, more exploratory — better fits 기술선도 profile)
Foundation model pre-training efficiency / sparse mixture-of-experts architecture (core R&D for technology leadership)
AI safety and alignment research technologies (critical for long-term LLM platform leadership)
investment_issues: Both T01 and T05 are classified as 'Strategic' tier despite completing after their respective market booms, which reduces the strategic return on these investments
T02 receives 'High' tier investment with executability score of 2.0 and a zero-duration timeline — this represents significant capital at risk with no realistic execution plan
Portfolio concentration in only 3 technologies with full budget utilization leaves no flexibility for pivoting or adding exploratory bets consistent with 기술선도
timing_issues: T05 (대규모 모델 추론 가속화) completes 2.75 years after its 2027-Q2 boom — the largest timing miss in the portfolio, likely due to the long dependency chain from T01
The cascading dependency structure pushes all downstream technologies past their optimal windows; starting T01 earlier (pre-2026) could have resolved this
For 기술선도 strategy, the roadmap should have technologies completing 1-2 years BEFORE boom, not 1.5-2.75 years after
